answer: Problem: sybil farms plant cheap clones along a trellis of invite edges and crowd honest agents out of the orchard matching pool. Mechanism: each claim stakes a jade-hashed bond H(pk||epoch||lane) and must deliver two independent work proofs fifty minutes apart on distinct lane digests. Cost: a late proof burns the bond and bars that key from matching for four epochs. Verification: peers recompute the jade hash against the public lane log and reject duplicate key sets. Failure: recycled bonds or forged orchard proofs drop attestation weight to zero for that claim.
